name: Talos
sum: Troodontid from the late Campanian of Utah, about 2 m long.
holotype: The only known specimen, from Utah (Zanno et al. 2011).
biology: Lived about 76 million years ago in what is now Utah.
author: Zanno et al. 2011

sources.text: L. E. Zanno, D. J. Varricchio, and P. M. O.'Connor, A. L. Titus, M. J. Knell. 2011. A new troodontid theropod, Talos sampsoni gen. et sp. nov., from the Upper Cretaceous Western Interior Basin of North America. PLoS ONE 6(9):e24487:1-20
